 Get Your Grind On!
 With two locations on the Alabama Gulf Coast, The Southern Grind has been the beach’s specialty coffee house since 2012. More than a coffee house, The Southern Grind offers comfort food to fresh food including, vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free options. We are known for homemade desserts, pastries, muffins, cookies and brownies as well as Gelato (Italian Ice Cream.) Enjoy free Wi-Fi surrounded by a cool, coastal vibe where you can shop for home decor, jewelry and local art or relax in our pet-friendly outdoor patio. Check for daily breakfast and lunch specials. Need a pick me up? Try our Nitro Draft Cold Brew Coffee and get your grind on!
